scientific_integrity: The general Chebyshev polynomial formula and an arbitrary-Stieltjes-matrix positivity frontier are acknowledged prior results. The new claim is the unweighted tree minimum order, double-star threshold, and exact edge-degree graph criterion, with exact symbolic proof and supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: Sharp minimum order concerns only unweighted connected trees and the exact-endpoint degree-three completed Chebyshev polynomial; no general weighted-tree minimum, higher-degree classification, or internal-stage monotonicity is established.
title: Twelve vertices are sharp for loss of positivity in three-step Chebyshev inverses on trees
